<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.

Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

The one-batch benchmark's dummy tree cache omits `req_to_token_pool`. The shared allocation path now reads both pools from that cache through `allocation._storage()`, so benchmark prefill crashes before inference:

```text
AttributeError: 'TreeCacheNamespace' object has no attribute 'req_to_token_pool'
```

Observed on both platforms while testing #46623:
- [XPU breakable-graph test](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40812402872/job/123245676561)
- [Xeon AMX benchmark test](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40812402949/job/123245685163)

This is a shared benchmark wiring issue, not a device-kernel change. The failure reproduces on upstream main at `60d56ea943b74d8fc1ccf59bb3cfb4f9dedfc3fd`.

## Modifications

- Pass the model runner's existing request pool into the benchmark's `TreeCacheNamespace`.
- Keep this PR to the one-line wiring fix; existing XPU breakable-graph and Xeon AMX benchmark tests exercise the affected path.

No serving configuration, model math, or kernel behavior changes.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Historical local regression verification using a temporary CPU test (removed from the final diff at the maintainer's request):

- `PYTHONPATH=python /home/mingfeima/.venv/bin/python -m pytest test/registered/unit/bench/test_one_batch.py -q --tb=short`
  - Before the fix: **1 failed**, reproducing the exact `TreeCacheNamespace.req_to_token_pool` AttributeError.
  - After the fix: **1 passed**.
- `PYTHONPATH=python /home/mingfeima/.venv/bin/python test/registered/unit/bench/test_one_batch.py -f`
  - **Passed: 1 test**, using the CI-style file entry point.
Current final-diff checks:

- `pre-commit run --files python/sglang/benchmark/one_batch.py`
  - **Passed**, including isort, Ruff, and formatting.
- `git diff --check`
  - **Passed**.

Full-model accuracy and XPU/Xeon benchmark reruns were **not run locally**; no accelerator/model launch was required for this allocation regression.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Not run; no performance claim. This fixes a pre-inference exception with a single additional reference in the dummy cache.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

No new test file is included; existing XPU/Xeon benchmark CI covers this path. Documentation and full-model accuracy/speed benchmarks are not applicable to this internal benchmark wiring fix.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
